prompt: A photorealistic image of a stylised neuron / dendrite diagram whose finest branch endings each carry a small cyan light. The structure branches repeatedly, and it has EXACTLY 12 outermost TIP ends (branch endings that do not split any further), each marked as described. Count of tip ends must be EXACTLY 12 -- not 11, not 13. The forks and the main trunk are NOT tips. Each tip mark is separate and clearly visible. No text, no numerals.
easy_question: This image was supposed to depict a single branching structure (like a tree or river network) whose outermost tips (the ends of the branches that do not split further) are each marked; count the tip ends. Ignoring artistic quality, does the image actually DEPICT that requested subject / carrier / scene -- the physical object, document, board, or diagram it describes? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram of the requested subject ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of the requested subject depicted, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q: How many cyan lights are in this image? These mark the END TIPS of the branching structure (the ends that do not split further); count every tip end, not the forks or the trunk. Count them one by one. Answer with the integer number only.
reference.q_notext: Does this image have any printed number, digit, numeral, written label or caption overlaid on it (as opposed to being purely a photograph / drawing of the scene with no text)? Answer yes if you can see ANY printed number or word, no if there is none. Answer yes or no only.
reference.d2_q_objform: This image should show the countable objects described as: a single branching structure (like a tree or river network) whose outermost tips (the ends of the branches that do not split further) are each marked; count the tip ends. Look at the individual objects being counted. Are they clearly the correct KIND of object (the right thing, of the right colour where a colour was specified) rather than some other object, blobs, or a mix that does not match the description? Answer with the single word yes or no only.
reference.d2_q_occlusion: Look at the objects being counted in this image. Is EVERY one of them visible as its own separate individual (allowing for the intended overlaps/stacking the scene describes), rather than merged into one indistinct blob? Answer yes if each intended object can be told apart, no if they merge into an uncountable mass. Answer with the single word yes or no only.

steps.read_crop: This close-up is cut from a picture of a repeatedly branching structure whose outermost branch endings are each capped with a small bright coloured marker (a red bud, a yellow tag or a small cyan light). Is such a bright tip marker visible in this picture (as opposed to only background, or only bare branch with no marker)? Answer yes or no only.

steps.ask: Does this image show a branching structure (repeatedly splitting into smaller branches) with its outermost tip ends marked? Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: a clump where several cyan-lit branch tips run together so the separate tips cannot be told apart
